fixedText.text: minimum_viable_rotation_size (rule of thumb we now enforce) N = minimum engineers needed so that ONE person being unavailable for up to 3 weeks does not raise anyone else's shift frequency by more than 25% Practically, for a weekly primary rotation: N < 5 -> a single absence raises remaining load by 25%+ (fragile) N = 6 -> absence raises load by ~20% (tight but survivable) N >= 7 -> absence raises load by <=17% (resilient) We now require N >= 6 before a service goes into an independent rotation; below that, it shares a pool with an adjacent team.
